scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/client && npm run build --workspace=packages/api
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=packages/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace=packages/api && npm run test:unit --workspace=packages/client -- --run
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.api:types: npm run build --workspace=packages/api && node packages/api/dist/openapi/generate.js packages/api/dist/openapi.json && openapi-typescript packages/api/dist/openapi.json --root-types --root-types-no-schema-prefix -o packages/client/src/api/generated/schema.ts && prettier --write packages/client/src/api/generated/schema.ts --config packages/client/.prettierrc.json
